profile.headline: NICE Software Engineer | Software Designer
profile.summary: As a Junior to Mid-Level Full-Stack Engineer, my experience leans toward the backend as a Java developer with a full understanding of the SDLC. I’m a self-starter, learn new technologies quickly, and excel at architecting new software features while thinking outside the box. My next career goal is to become a team lead to be directly involved in the design process and mentor my team members.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Kubernetes · MySQL · C# · Jira · Confluence

positions.title: Backend Engineer & Salesforce Developer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
· Led development and management of internal Java and Spring Boot SaaS systems using GitHub and IntelliJ, integrating with Salesforce and Quickbooks to create invoices and end-user serials automatically.
· Built an API with Java and Spring Boot for Xima’s contact center software to create new Salesforce records automatically when external calls come in. Also authored documentation for the API.
· Spearheaded a Javascript plugin allowing Xima's contact center software to run within Salesforce, connecting Xima’s end-users with Salesforce contacts and company records.
· Efficiently managed changing priorities, transitioning between Java and Spring Boot backend development and sales escalations to meet and fulfill internal and external needs promptly.
· Skills & Technologies Used: Spring Boot, Java, Salesforce, GitHub, SaaS, JavaScript, Visual Studio, IntelliJ, Notion
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Software as a Service (SaaS) · Git · Salesforce.com Development · Spring Boot

positions.locationName: Salt Lake City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid

positions.title: Junior Backend Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Interim team lead of backend Java and Spring Boot WebRTC Recording feature, designing microservices running on Kubernetes to record contact center calls. Created and led a testing initiative to find bugs and problems pre-release.
· Developed the Java and Spring Boot backend for 5 new contact center features hosted on Kubernetes and stored in GitLab, on an agile team of 6 developers. Elevated the marketability and feature count of Xima’s flagship product.
· Increased team productivity by 46% by taking charge of scrum master responsibilities, leading the full SDLC design of new features, and strengthening communication between developers and the product team through daily meetings.
· Skills & Technologies Used: Spring Boot, Java, Kubernetes, GitLab, Microservices, Angular, Unit Testing, Mockito, Jira, Agile Development, SaaS, SDLC, Scrum, Cypress, IntelliJ, Visual Studio, Notion, Google Workspace

projects.title: Ski Resort Web Application
projects.description:
· Designed the backend and frontend of a dynamic web application using Java, Spring Boot, Angular, and Postgres, replicating functionalities of a ski resort and enabling end-users to purchase ski passes and access lift schedules.
· Demonstrated adeptness in full-stack development and presented a production-level software solution.
· Skills and Technologies Used: Spring Boot, Angular, Java, Postgres, AWS RDS, GitHub

projects.title: WebRTC Recording
projects.description: Managed the development of a real-time audio recording system for WebRTC streams, taking initiative in the absence of the team lead. Collaborated with Software Architects to meticulously plan and execute the four key components, managed Jira ticketing, and actively contributed throughout the entire software development lifecycle.
